OUSD's record is a 'Grant Award' funded by 'The California Wellness Foundation Grant', and this organization is a grantmaker that says public school districts may apply directly
The foundation has an Oakland office (499 14th Street, Suite 300), consistent with funding Oakland-area work
research.notes: Confidence medium: the agenda gives San Francisco, CA, but the foundation's headquarters is in Los Angeles with an Oakland office; no San Francisco office is listed. No page directly linking the foundation to an OUSD grant was found. The name is distinctive and the vendor is plainly a grantor, so this is likely right, but the location mismatch and missing OUSD link keep it below high. General email omitted because the site shows it as 'info(at)calwellness.org'.

profile.summary: A private, independent foundation that makes grants to organizations working to protect and improve health and wellness in California. Its grantmaking focuses on community well-being, economic security, equity in access to care, and leadership for change. It has offices in Los Angeles and Oakland.
